    • components/math

    Class TpMath

    renders LaTeX or AsciiMath expressions as inline or display-style SVG.

    Example

    <p>The identity <tp-math value="a^2 + b^2 = c^2" label="a squared plus b squared equals c squared"></tp-math> describes a right triangle.</p>

    Tagname

    tp-math

    Attr

    value = "" - Expression without surrounding math delimiters.

    Attr

    src = "" - Expression file; takes precedence over value and inline content.

    Attr

    mode = "latexmath" - Mathematical input notation.

    Attr

    displaystyle = false - Uses display-style mathematics in a centered block instead of inline mathematics.

    Attr

    label = "" - Accessible description of the formula; defaults to its source text. tp-math-rendered Emitted after the current expression is rendered successfully.

    Eventdetail

    tp-math-rendered { value: string; mode: TpMathMode; displaystyle: boolean } tp-math-error Emitted when loading or rendering the current expression fails.

    Eventdetail

    tp-math-error { message: string }

    Accessibility

    The SVG has an accessible name; label can provide a readable description instead of source notation.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Describe complex expressions with label or surrounding explanatory text.
